overall_assessment: Anonymization works well for NIH: none of the 8 packet courses (all random controls, since the pre-pass flagged nothing among the 81 offerings) contains names, e-mails, phone numbers or admin dates, and the only removals are semester-year stamps on the reading-list line ('Pensumliste for våren 2025.', 'Anbefalt litteratur for høsten2025.'). These are correctly removed and leave a harmless dangling 'for .'; no course content (week numbers, '8-18 år', '4000 ord', unyeared 'vårsemesteret') was lost. A scan of all 81 NIH plans outside the packet confirms no PII and finds one leftover the regexes miss: nih_LKI200-1_2025_autumn_1 keeps the abbreviated semester code 'Pensumliste for H2025-V2026.' (fix: add str_remove_all("\\b[HV](?:19|20)\\d{2}\\b") to .anon_generic() with a test), plus a cosmetic broken archive URL '…/program-og-emneplan-arkiv//.' after the academic-year removal.
